Unpack+pack formats ARE already reconfigured at cull->blend boundary yet bug persists -> residual hazard is below format-reconfig (SrcA/DEST bank reuse / DEST full-sync / SFPU LREG). Clean fix init_sfpu()/unary_op_init_common mid-kernel DEADLOCKS (re-runs UNPACK/PACK hw_configure with pending CBs; wedged device x2).
